name: Htaccess
description: Administrative interface for combining Drupal's default .htaccess with custom Apache directives and writing the site's root .htaccess file.
project_description: The 3.x branch of Htaccess is a rewrite of the original project for Drupal ^10 and ^11. It provides a single administrative form (at /admin/config/system/htaccess, gated by the restrict-access permission 'administer htaccess') that loads Drupal's default scaffold .htaccess content, shows it in a read-only preview, and lets an administrator append custom Apache directives in an 'extra configurations' textarea. On save it concatenates the default content with the extra directives and writes the result to the site's root .htaccess; an optional checkbox makes hook_cron() rewrite the file from configuration on every cron run. A status-report requirement flags when clean URLs are disabled or the docroot is not writable. The project also ships a companion submodule, Robots.txt Utils (robotstxt_utils), which adds a checkbox to the Robotstxt module's settings form to delete the physical robots.txt file on save and on cron, so search engines read the dynamically generated version.
